linkageConfig.title: Record linkage configuration
linkageConfig.description: Configure how this attribute is normalized, compared, weighted and optionally transformed for privacy-preserving record linkage.

linkageConfigHelp.tags: Semantic tags describe what the attribute represents. By default, TrustDeck uses the entity type name followed by the attribute name, for example person.firstName.
linkageConfigHelp.privacyMode: PPRL transforms linkage values before comparison. Plain mode keeps values usable for non-private blocking or comparison workflows.
linkageConfigHelp.weight: Relative importance of this attribute during record linkage. Higher values make a match on this attribute count more strongly.
linkageConfigHelp.pprlMethod: n-gram Bloom Filter encodes approximate string similarity. HMAC-based exact matching supports exact equality without storing the clear value.
linkageConfigHelp.ngramSize: Number of characters per n-gram before Bloom-filter encoding. A value of 2 is common for names.
linkageConfigHelp.bloomLength: Length of the Bloom filter bit array. Larger values reduce collisions but increase storage size.
linkageConfigHelp.hashPositions: Number of hash-derived Bloom-filter positions set for each n-gram. Higher values can make similar values easier to match, but may also increase the chance of unrelated values overlapping. Default: 10.
linkageConfigHelp.bandSize: Size used for banded candidate generation or indexing of Bloom filters. Use the backend default unless you have a reason to tune it.

normalizerHelp.collapseWhitespace: Replaces repeated whitespace with a single space.
normalizerHelp.asciiFold: Converts accented characters to ASCII where possible.
normalizerHelp.umlautFold: Normalizes German umlauts such as ä/ae, ö/oe, and ü/ue for matching.
normalizerHelp.removePunctuation: Removes punctuation characters before linkage comparison.
normalizerHelp.digitsOnly: Keeps digits only, useful for postal codes or phone-like identifiers.

encoderHelp.cologne: Cologne phonetic encoding; mainly useful for German-language names and German pronunciation patterns.
encoderHelp.doubleMetaphone: Double Metaphone phonetic encoding; mainly useful for English-language names and many international pronunciation variants.

blockingHelp.exact: Uses the normalized value itself as a blocking key.
blockingHelp.prefix3: Uses the first three characters as a blocking key.
blockingHelp.prefix4: Uses the first four characters as a blocking key.
blockingHelp.prefix6: Uses the first six characters as a blocking key.
blockingHelp.phonetic: Uses a phonetic encoding as the blocking key.
blockingHelp.year: Uses the year part as a blocking key.
blockingHelp.yearMonth: Uses year and month as a blocking key.
blockingHelp.domainExact: Uses a group-specific exact blocking key.

groupCreate.title: Create new group
groupCreate.description: Create a new group and assign it to this entity type. The group settings define how pseudonyms are generated.
groupCreate.name: Group name
groupCreate.validationDetail: Enter a group name, a pseudonym prefix, and a pseudonym length of at least 4.
groupCreate.createdDetail: The new group was created and assigned to this entity type.
groupCreate.customAlphabetRequired: Enter the characters that are allowed in the custom alphabet.
groupCreate.customAlphabetNoSemicolon: The alphabet must not contain a semicolon.
groupCreate.checkDigitAlphabetEven: When check digits are enabled, the alphabet must contain an even number of characters.
groupCreate.inheritedEditable: Inherited from parent group; edit to override.

groupCreateHelp.parentGroup: Optional parent group. Leave empty to create a top-level group.
groupCreateHelp.pseudonymLength: Total length of generated pseudonym values, excluding the prefix.
groupCreateHelp.algorithm: Algorithm used to generate pseudonym values for this group.
groupCreateHelp.alphabet: Character set used for generated pseudonyms when the selected algorithm allows configurable alphabets.
groupCreateHelp.randomAlgorithmDesiredSize: Expected maximum number of pseudonyms for random generation. This helps evaluate collision risk.
groupCreateHelp.paddingCharacter: Single character used to pad shorter generated values up to the configured pseudonym length.
groupCreateHelp.multiplePsnAllowed: Allows the same identifier to receive more than one pseudonym in this group.
groupCreateHelp.addCheckDigit: Adds a final check digit that can help detect typing or transcription errors.
groupCreateHelp.groupDescription: Optional description for administrators to document the purpose of this group.
groupCreateHelp.customAlphabetCharacters: Enter every character that may appear in generated pseudonyms. This is a literal character list, not a regular expression, for example abcdefghijklmno1234,.-*+.
groupCreateHelp.randomAlgorithmDesiredSuccessProbability: Target probability that a random pseudonym can be generated without collision. Use a value between 0 and 1, for example 0.99999998 in English or 0,99999998 in German.
groupCreateHelp.consecutiveValueCounter: Starting counter used when the consecutive-number algorithm is selected.
groupCreateHelp.validFrom: Optional start date and time for values created in this group. Leave empty to use the backend default or the parent group setting.
groupCreateHelp.validTo: Optional end date and time for values created in this group. Leave empty to use the validity period or the parent group setting.
groupCreateHelp.validityTime: Optional validity period used to calculate the end date when no explicit valid-to date is entered. Examples: 3days, 1 day, 50 day, 7w, or 5 y. Supported units include years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds, and nanoseconds. If a valid-to date is provided, the validity period is ignored.
groupCreateHelp.salt: Optional explicit salt used for pseudonym generation. Leave empty so the backend generates a salt.
groupCreateHelp.saltLength: Backend default is 32. Increase this only when you need a longer generated salt.
groupCreateHelp.lengthIncludesCheckDigit: When enabled, the check digit counts as part of the configured pseudonym length instead of being added on top.
groupCreateHelp.enforceStartDateValidity: Requires created values to start no earlier than this group allows.
groupCreateHelp.enforceEndDateValidity: Requires created values to end no later than this group allows.
